ev.q: The body of evidence for the Janssen COVID-19 vaccine was primarily informed by one international Phase III clinical trial
Interim findings from this clinical trial indicate that the Janssen COVID-19 vaccine efficacy against symptomatic, laboratory-confirmed COVID-19 was 66.3%
issued an interim recommendation for use of the Janssen COVID-19 vaccine in persons aged ≥18 years
ACIP used the Evidence to Recommendations (EtR) framework

methods_quotes.q: After a systematic review of available data, the work group used the GRADE approach to assess the certainty of evidence
This GRADE review conducted by CDC was based on vaccine efficacy of any PCR-confirmed moderate to severe/critical COVID-19 case
